description: Manages associations or connections between different entities within the system, such as partners, projects, or other business objects.

endpoints.name: GetLinks
endpoints.description: Retrieves a paginated list of links associated with a specific entity and its identifier. This allows fetching all connections related to a particular business object.

entity.description: The type of the entity for which to retrieve links (e.g., 'Partner', 'Project').

entityId.description: The unique identifier of the specific entity instance.

parameters.description: Pagination and sorting parameters (e.g., page number, page size, sort order).

example_uses: Get all links associated with a partner whose ID is 123.
Retrieve connections related to project 456, showing the first 10 results.
List all associations for the 'Contact' entity with ID 789.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch existing links for a particular business entity, such as a partner, project, or contact, when you know its type and ID and need to see its related connections.

endpoints.name: Create
endpoints.description: Creates a new link between entities. This establishes a new association record in the system.

req.description: The request body containing the details for the new link, including the entities to be linked and any link-specific properties.

example_uses: Create a new link between a partner and a project.
Establish a new association record for a document and a task.
Add a connection entry to the system for two related items.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to establish a new relationship or connection between two or more entities in the system.

endpoints.name: Update
endpoints.description: Updates an existing link. This allows modification of an established association record.

req.description: The request body containing the updated details for the link, including its ID and any properties to be modified.

example_uses: Modify the details of an existing link, such as changing its description.
Update an association record to reflect a change in status.
Change the properties of a connection between two entities.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to modify the details or properties of an already existing link.

endpoints.name: Delete
endpoints.description: Deletes a link by its unique identifier. This permanently removes the association record from the system.

id.description: The unique identifier of the link to be deleted.

example_uses: Remove a specific association between two entities.
Break a connection by its identifier.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to permanently remove a specific link from the system using its unique identifier.
